scope: NFS-03 latest-draft autosave loss only; Notes list/create/read failures remain separate findings.
root_cause: The debounced save and Append path called persist while an earlier request was in flight. persist returned without retaining the newer draft; the older response then reported Saved. A component reused for another note also shared the same in-flight flag.
correction: One serialized persistence drain retains the latest draft across debounce, Append, and unmount cleanup. After each response it compares the draft actually written with the latest editor draft and writes the newer one before reporting Saved.
The Notes view keys the editor by note ID, so an old note's completion cannot write into or mark a new note saved.

Failed drafts remain in sidepanel memory across note switches and reopen with an honest Unsaved changes/Save failed state and Retry save action. Successful writes remove their matching recoverable draft.
regression_cases: restoring the exact saved draft before debounce starts no write and clears Saving; restoring during an older pending write waits for the restoration write
newer edit during first pending write reaches storage and Saved waits for that write
switching notes during a write preserves each note's content and separate status
Append from page during pending autosave reaches storage
unmount with a queued newer draft still writes it after the older request settles
failed draft survives a note switch and can be saved with Retry save

peer_followup.finding: D63-PEER-01: edit then exact revert left Saving visible indefinitely when the queued draft already equaled the saved snapshot.
peer_followup.correction: The equal-to-saved branch settles status only when the current editor draft still equals that snapshot and no newer draft is queued. An older in-flight write is completed before this branch can run; a return to the prior value during that write therefore takes a trailing write and waits for its success.
